Title: New networking features for App Service Linux are now in preview

Body.Content:
App Service on Linux now supports Virtual Network integration, which has been a common request from customers. This new feature enables Linux based web applications to access resources in virtual networks, service endpoint-secured entities, and on-premises locations through ExpressRoute or site-to-site VPN. It’s available in standard and premium Azure App Service plans and is now in preview.

Learn more
